items.title: Andrew Morgan Interview, 1961-07-04
items.q: Well then I played around Boydman Street. Played out there with Bill Matthews. And continued on playing with Bill Matthews now when he had dates

ctx.x: Well I remember hearing down the country violin. Yeah. I remember later Bunk said he'd like for you to be, wish you could have gone to New York and played with him once. Yeah. So you told me that one time. He'd like to use you on clarinet.
Well then I played around Boydman Street. Played out there with Bill Matthews. And continued on playing with Bill Matthews now when he had dates, you know. Yeah.
I remember hearing you at the paddock quite often there.
